cloud: Designed and implemented cloud-native infrastructure platforms using Docker and Kubernetes to support scalable engineering workloads.
Architected Kubernetes-based execution platforms on Alibaba Cloud ACK with secure internal networking and namespace isolation.
Implemented Kubernetes autoscaling strategies using KEDA driven by real-time Prometheus metrics to optimize infrastructure utilization.
Increased infrastructure execution capacity by approximately 3× while maintaining platform stability and controlled cloud costs.
Built Terraform-based automation for Alibaba Cloud to provision ECS, VPC, Security Groups, RAM roles, OSS, and ACK prerequisites using CLI-only workflows.
Implemented ephemeral, TTL-based infrastructure provisioning for demos and experimentation, reducing idle cloud resource costs by approximately 40%.
Designed secure cloud networking models including private container registries, internal-only services, secrets management, and environment isolation.
Enabled environment-agnostic infrastructure deployments across dev, SIT, UAT, and production environments.
Ensured cloud platforms complied with enterprise security, governance, and regulatory requirements in government environments.
Provided architectural guidance on cloud resilience, fault tolerance, and high availability.
devops: Architected fully automated, multi-stage, multi-repository CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI for enterprise platforms.
Designed reusable pipeline templates supporting commit-level, merge-request, post-deploy, scheduled, and on-demand executions.
Enabled parallel and containerized workload execution across multiple enterprise programs using shared and dedicated GitLab runners.
Reduced overall CI/CD pipeline execution time by up to 70% through optimized pipeline design, parallelization, and caching strategies.
Automated artifact lifecycle management including build outputs, logs, execution traces, and operational reports.
Implemented DevOps governance standards to ensure consistency, auditability, and repeatability across pipelines.
Integrated security, quality, and operational checks directly into delivery workflows.
Collaborated with cloud, security, and development teams to embed DevOps best practices across the organization.
Improved delivery reliability and reduced deployment-related failures through standardized pipelines and automation.

Architected fully automated CI/CD multi-staging multi-repo pipelines using GitLab for running cross-browser, parallel, containerized test suites on in-house HRDF runners (1HRDF, CGP_Irshad, Jadarat, NLO etc).
cloud_devops_gitops: Designed and implemented a GitOps-based delivery platform using Alibaba Cloud ACK, GitLab repositories, GitLab Container Registry, and ArgoCD.
Established separation of concerns between application repositories and GitOps infrastructure repositories to improve governance and auditability.
Implemented automated pipelines to build, tag, and push container images while programmatically updating GitOps manifests.
Enabled declarative, version-controlled Kubernetes deployments with automated synchronization and rollback capabilities.
Integrated Kubernetes secrets and registry authentication for secure image pulls within ACK clusters.
Reduced deployment errors by approximately 60% through GitOps-based consistency and state reconciliation.
Improved deployment traceability and audit readiness by maintaining full version history of infrastructure and application state.
Reduced environment recovery time and deployment-related incidents through automated rollback and reconciliation.
test_automation: Designed and led the development of enterprise-grade test automation frameworks using Selenium and Playwright across Java, Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript ecosystems.
Implemented robust framework architectures using Page Object Model (POM), modular design, reusable components, and multi-threaded execution.
Enabled large-scale parallel test execution, reducing regression execution time by approximately 93%.
Built unified test automation frameworks covering web UI and API validation.
Integrated advanced reporting solutions with custom branding, dashboards, hooks, and leadership-friendly visibility.
Reduced flaky test failures by approximately 70% through improved synchronization, retries, and environment stabilization.
Led framework migrations, upgrades, and dependency patching to maintain stability and security.
Established automation coding standards, governance models, and review processes across internal and vendor teams.
Improved overall quality confidence and release predictability across enterprise programs.
Designed and led the development of advanced Selenium and Playwright automation frameworks using Java/Python/JS/TypeScript, TestNG/JUnit5, Cucumber, Maven/Gradle.
Implemented nested/Multi-threading container patterns and POM architecture, including technology migration with server caching, stored procedures, and private network communication protocols.
Enabled stable, scalable execution using Remote Grid Infrastructure, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes.
performance: Designed and implemented enterprise-grade performance engineering platforms using k6, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Built performance test suites covering load, stress, spike, endurance, and saturation testing scenarios.
Designed custom Grafana dashboards visualizing latency, throughput, error rates, RPS, VUs, p95/p99 response times, and resource saturation metrics.
Enabled performance testing execution in both persistent VM-based observability environments and CI/CD pipeline-driven executions.
Identified scalability bottlenecks and performance risks prior to production release.
Improved application response latency by up to 35% through early detection and remediation of performance issues.
Reduced Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) by approximately 30% through improved observability and monitoring visibility.
Supported capacity planning and scalability forecasting using historical performance trend analysis.
Increased leadership confidence in system scalability and reliability through data-driven performance insights.
Led vendor teams to orchestrate end-to-end performance engineering initiatives at an organizational scale.
Designed synthetic monitoring strategies covering latency, RPS, VUs, error rates, and saturation metrics.
leadership: Managed and guided vendor engineering teams across automation, performance, and DevOps tracks.
Established best practices, coding standards, and governance processes across QA teams.
Provided architectural guidance for multi-agent systems, k6 scenarios, and distributed test frameworks.
Contributed directly to improving delivery timelines, reducing flakiness, and increasing quality confidence for major releases.

Delivered measurable impact: reducing regression time by 93%, cutting CI/CD duration by 70%, lowering flaky tests by 70%, increasing capacity by 3×, improving latency by up to 35%, reducing MTTR by 30%, and improving vendor productivity by 30%.
ai: Designed and implemented an AI-driven Executive Decision Support System to assist HRDF leadership in optimizing national training programs.
Built AI-based decision logic to analyze training utilization, demand patterns, effectiveness indicators, and outcome metrics.
Enabled leadership to identify underutilized, overfunded, or low-impact training programs and redirect investment to high-impact initiatives.
Developed scenario-based decision models to simulate demand surges, capacity constraints, and budget inefficiencies.
Translated complex program and operational data into executive-friendly insights aligned with policy and organizational objectives.
Demonstrated potential to improve training ROI and optimize allocation of multi-million-riyal training budgets.
Reduced manual analysis and reporting effort by approximately 50%, enabling faster executive decision cycles.
Positioned AI as a strategic advisory capability for workforce planning and policy decisions.
